result.scope_note: Under the 2026 NIST listing, there are 20 SI base units and 24 SI prefixes (yotta, zetta, exa, peta, tera, giga, mega, kilo, hecto, deca, deci, centi, milli, micro, nano, pico, femto, atto, zepto, yocto, and two supplemental prefixes). Therefore, SI prefixes outnumber SI base units.

excerpts.text: The following table of 24 SI prefixes ranging from 1030 to 10−30 are currently recognized for use.

| 1795 | Eight original SI prefixes were officially adopted: deca, hecto, kilo, myria, deci, centi, milli, and myrio, derived from Greek and Latin numbers. Initially, all prefixes were represented by lowercase symbols. | 8 |
| 2022 | Four prefixes were added. Two for forming multiples: ronna and quetta. Two forming submultiples: ronto and quecto. | 24 |
